exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — KUNDALIK TARTIB.

Sarlavha: 'An Early Bird or a Night Owl?'
  an early bird — erta turadigan odam
  a night owl   — kech yotadigan odam

Ikkalasi ham QUSH obrazi:
  Maqol: 'The early bird catches the worm'
         (Erta turgan qush qurtni tutadi)
         O'zbekchada: 'Erta turgan er oshini topar'
  Boyqush (owl) esa KECHASI ov qiladi — shuning uchun
  kech yotadigan odamni 'night owl' deyishadi.

Rasmda Bob Ellis — delfin murabbiyi. U delfin ustida turibdi.

tasks.prompt: 1  The man in the picture is Bob Ellis. He is a ____ .
tasks.whyUz: Rasmda delfin bilan ishlaydi. Matnda ham: 'Bob Ellis, 29, is a dolphin trainer'. Akula (shark) o'rgatilmaydi.
Matnda: 'He arrives at the aquarium at half past six'. Basseyn — u faqat suzish uchun boradi.
U murabbiy: delfinlarni boqadi va o'rgatadi. Akvarium tozalash — boshqa odamning ishi.
Matnda: 'It is tiring though, as I work long hours'. U ishini YOQTIRADI — demak zerikarli emas.

tasks.whyUz: Boyqush KECHASI ov qiladi, demak KUNDUZI uxlaydi. Shuning uchun kech yotadigan odamni 'night owl' deyishadi.

exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (12 ta):
  an early, gets, has, arrives, long, a night, free,
  goes to, goes, watches, catches, afraid of

Har biri FAQAT BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

IKKI GURUH:
  1) OT BIRIKMALARI (1, 2, 3, 11):
     long walks, an early bird, a night owl, free time

     hammasi 3-shaxs birlik shaklida (He + fe'l+S)

DIQQAT — 'goes' va 'goes to' farqi:
  He GOES home.      ('to' YO'Q — 'home' oldida hech qachon 'to' bo'lmaydi)
  He GOES TO bed.    ('to' BOR)

'watch TV' = televizor ko'rmoq. -ch → watchES. Artikl YO'Q.
'go TO bed' = yotmoq. Bu yerda 'to' BOR, 'the' esa yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing — har bir gapning tarjimasi va izohi berilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA: 'Around the Clock with Bob Ellis'
  'around the clock' — sutka bo'yi, kun bo'yi
  (soat strelkasi butun aylanani bosib o'tadi degani)

MATN TARTIBI — KUN BO'YICHA:
  1) kasbi va unga munosabati
  2) ertalab: turish → dush → kiyinish → nonushta → yo'l
  3) ish: delfin boqish → mashq → tushlik → tomosha
  4) kechqurun: uy, televizor, erta yotish
  5) bo'sh vaqt: sayr, suzish
  6) hayotdan qoniqish

BUTUN MATN PRESENT SIMPLE da — chunki bu KUNDALIK TARTIB.
Har bir fe'lga qarang: 'gets', 'has', 'catches', 'arrives',
'feeds' — hammasi 3-shaxs birlik -s bilan.

tasks.en: Around the Clock with Bob Ellis
Bob Ellis, 29, is a dolphin trainer.
tasks.note: Gazetalarda yosh ism bilan vergul orasida beriladi: 'Bob Ellis, 29, is ...'

tasks.en: "I like my job a lot because I love working with animals," he says.
tasks.uz: 'Ishimni juda yoqtiraman, chunki hayvonlar bilan ishlashni yaxshi ko'raman', — deydi u.
tasks.note: 'love' dan keyin -ING: love WORKING. 'work WITH' — bilan ishlamoq.

tasks.en: "It is tiring though, as I work long hours."
tasks.uz: 'Lekin bu charchatadi, chunki ko'p soat ishlayman.'
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: long hours = uzoq ish soatlari.
'though' = lekin (gap o'rtasida ham bo'ladi).
'as' bu yerda 'chunki' ma'nosida (because bilan bir xil).

tasks.en: His day starts at five o'clock in the morning.
tasks.uz: Uning kuni ertalab soat beshda boshlanadi.
tasks.note: Soat bilan AT. 'in the morning' — ertalab.

tasks.en: He gets up, has a shower, and then he gets dressed.
tasks.uz: U turadi, dush qabul qiladi, so'ng kiyinadi.
tasks.note:
UCH TURG'UN BIRIKMA:
  get up — turmoq (uyqudan)
  have a shower — dush qabul qilmoq
  get dressed — kiyinmoq

tasks.en: After breakfast, at about six o'clock, he catches the bus to work.
tasks.uz: Nonushtadan keyin, taxminan soat oltida, u ishga avtobusga chiqadi.
tasks.note:
'catch the bus' = avtobusga chiqmoq (ushlamoq emas!).
'at about six' — taxminan oltida.

tasks.en: He arrives at the aquarium at half past six and feeds the dolphins.
tasks.uz: U akvariumga olti yarimda yetib boradi va delfinlarni boqadi.
tasks.note:
'arrive AT' — kichik joyga (bino, bekat).
'half past six' = 6:30 (oltidan yarim o'tdi).

tasks.en: After that, they practise for the show until lunchtime.
tasks.uz: Shundan keyin ular tushlikkacha tomosha uchun mashq qilishadi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: practise = mashq qilmoq (Britan imlosi; AQShda 'practice').
'until' = ...gacha.

tasks.en: Bob has a break for lunch from half past twelve till half past one, then the show starts.
tasks.uz: Bob o'n ikki yarimdan bir yarimgacha tushlik uchun tanaffus qiladi, so'ng tomosha boshlanadi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: a break = tanaffus.
'from ... till ...' = ...dan ...gacha.

tasks.en: At five o'clock in the afternoon, he feeds the dolphins again and then he goes home.
tasks.uz: Kunduzi soat beshda u delfinlarni yana boqadi, so'ng uyga ketadi.

tasks.en: In the evening, Bob usually watches TV.
He doesn't go out very often during the week because he goes to bed early.
tasks.uz: U hafta davomida tez-tez ko'chaga chiqmaydi, chunki erta yotadi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: during = davomida; early = erta.
'go out' = ko'chaga chiqmoq, dam olishga chiqmoq.
'go to bed' — 'the' YO'Q.

tasks.en: And what does Bob do in his free time?
tasks.uz: Xo'sh, Bob bo'sh vaqtida nima qiladi?
tasks.note: Matn ichida savol — o'quvchi diqqatini yangi mavzuga tortadi.

tasks.en: He loves going for long walks in the countryside with his dog, Jack.
tasks.uz: U iti Jek bilan qishloqda uzoq sayr qilishni juda yaxshi ko'radi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: long walks = uzoq sayrlar; countryside = qishloq joy, shahardan tashqari.
'go for a walk' = sayrga chiqmoq.

tasks.en: Bob also likes swimming at the pool, but he never swims in the sea because he's afraid of sharks!
tasks.uz: Bob basseynda suzishni ham yoqtiradi, lekin dengizda hech qachon suzmaydi, chunki akuladan qo'rqadi!
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: afraid of = ...dan qo'rqmoq ('of' SHART).
'never' — inkor so'zi, 'doesn't' kerak emas.

tasks.en: "I feel very satisfied with my life at the moment," says Bob.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: feel = his qilmoq; satisfied = mamnun, qoniqqan.
'satisfied WITH' — 'with' shart. 'at the moment' = hozir.

tasks.en: "I've got a great job and I enjoy my free time. Who could ask for more?"
tasks.uz: 'Menda ajoyib ish bor va bo'sh vaqtimdan zavqlanaman. Bundan ortiq nima kerak?'
tasks.note: 'Who could ask for more?' — 'Bundan ortiq nima kerak?' — mamnunlikni bildiruvchi ibora.

tasks.whyUz: Britan imlosi -se bilan. AQShda 'practice'. Ot shakli Britaniyada ham 'practice'.
'have a break' = tanaffus qilmoq. 'break' fe'l sifatida — sindirmoq.
'during the week' = hafta davomida. Keyin OT keladi, gap emas.

'go for long walks' = uzoq sayr qilmoq.

'feel + sifat': feel happy, feel tired, feel satisfied.

MATN — Gollandiyadagi ish vaqtlari haqida sayyohlar uchun ma'lumot.

TO'RT BO'LIM:
  Shops              — do'konlar
  Banks and Post Offices — banklar va pochta bo'limlari
  Chemists           — dorixonalar
  Restaurants        — restoranlar

VAQT PREDLOGLARI (bu matndagi asosiy grammatika):
  FROM ... UNTIL ... — ...dan ...gacha
  ON Saturday        — shanba kuni
  Monday TO Friday   — dushanbadan jumagacha

AM va PM:
  am — tushdan OLDIN (00:00–11:59)
  pm — tushdan KEYIN (12:00–23:59)
  noon — tush payti, soat 12:00

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida vaqtni IKKI XIL aytish mumkin:

  1) AN'ANAVIY usul — past / to / quarter / half bilan
  2) RAQAMLI usul — shunchaki raqamlarni o'qish

MISOL: 6:45
  an'anaviy: (a) quarter to seven
  raqamli:   six forty-five

AN'ANAVIY USUL QOIDASI:

  DAQIQA 1–30 bo'lsa → PAST (o'tdi)
    6:15 → (a) quarter PAST six   (oltidan chorak o'tdi)
    6:20 → twenty PAST six
    6:30 → half PAST six

  DAQIQA 31–59 bo'lsa → TO (qoldi) va SOAT KEYINGISI
    6:45 → (a) quarter TO seven   (yettiga chorak qoldi)
    6:40 → twenty TO seven
    6:50 → ten TO seven

ESLAB QOLING:
  PAST — soat o'tgan qismi, SHU soat aytiladi
  TO   — soatgacha qolgan qism, KEYINGI soat aytiladi
rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO — 'to' bilan soatni noto'g'ri aytish:

  5:40 → twenty TO SIX     ✅ (oltiga yigirma qoldi)
         twenty to five    ❌

  6:45 → quarter TO SEVEN  ✅ (yettiga chorak qoldi)
         quarter to six    ❌

'to' ishlatilganda soat BITTAGA OSHADI!

Va 'o'clock' FAQAT to'liq soatda:
  ✅ six o'clock       (6:00)
  ❌ six fifteen o'clock
rule.noteUz:
'quarter' va 'half' oldidagi artikl:
  a quarter past six / quarter past six — IKKALASI ham to'g'ri
  half past six — 'a' QO'YILMAYDI ('a half past six' XATO)

RAQAMLI USUL — juda oson:
  6:45 → six forty-five
  9:20 → nine twenty
  10:15 → ten fifteen

Bu usul vokzal, aeroport va rasmiy joylarda ko'proq ishlatiladi.
An'anaviy usul esa kundalik suhbatda.
rule.extraUz:

Ikkalasi bir xil. Javob: 'It's ...'

SOAT BILAN PREDLOG — AT:
  at six o'clock, at half past six, at 6:45
  ('in six o'clock' yoki 'on six o'clock' XATO)

KUN QISMI:
  6:00 ertalab  → six o'clock in the morning
  6:00 kechqurun → six o'clock in the evening
  Rasmiy: 6 am / 6 pm

rule.explanationUz:
Takrorlanish ravishlari ish QANCHALIK TEZ-TEZ sodir bo'lishini
aytadi. Ular FOIZ shkalasi bo'ylab joylashadi:

  never      0%    — hech qachon
  rarely     10%   — kamdan-kam
  sometimes  25%   — ba'zan
  often      50%   — tez-tez
  usually    75%   — odatda
  always     100%  — doim

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — RAVISH QAYERDA TURADI:

  ODDIY fe'l bilan → fe'ldan OLDIN
    I USUALLY get up at half past seven.
    She NEVER goes climbing.

  'to be' fe'li bilan → fe'ldan KEYIN
    I am NEVER late for school.
    He is ALWAYS happy.

rules.uzRule: Takrorlanish ravishlari asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN keladi.
rules.enRule: Adverbs of frequency usually come before the main verb.
examples: I usually get up at half past seven in the morning.
She never goes climbing on Sundays.

rules.enRule: But they come after the verb "to be".
examples: I am never late for school.

rules.uzRule: Ular ish QANCHALIK TEZ-TEZ sodir bo'lishini aytadi.
rules.enRule: They tell us how often something happens.
examples: never 0%, rarely 10%, sometimes 25%, often 50%, usually 75%, always 100%

rule.warningUz:
'NEVER' O'ZI INKOR — ikkinchi inkor QO'SHILMAYDI:
  ✅ She NEVER goes climbing.
  ❌ She never doesn't go climbing.
  ❌ She doesn't never go climbing.

O'zbek tilida 'hech qachon BORMAYDI' — ikki inkor.
Ingliz tilida esa BITTA inkor yetarli.

Shuningdek 'rarely' ham inkor ma'nosini beradi:
  ✅ I rarely watch TV.  (kamdan-kam ko'raman)
rule.noteUz:

  Savol: Do you USUALLY get up early?

  Inkor: I don't USUALLY get up early.

'Sometimes' va 'usually' gap BOSHIDA ham kelishi mumkin:
  Sometimes I go to the cinema.
  Usually I get up at seven.
Lekin 'always' va 'never' gap boshida KELMAYDI.

rule.titleUz: AT / ON / IN — qaysi biri qachon
rule.explanationUz:
UCHTA PREDLOG, UCHTA QOIDA.
Ularni ANIQLIK darajasi bo'yicha eslash oson:

  AT — eng ANIQ nuqta (soat)
  ON — bir KUN
  IN — uzun DAVR (oy, fasl, yil)

  AT → ON → IN
  aniq  →  kun  →  uzoq davr

JADVAL (kitobdagi uchta ustun):

  AT                ON                  IN
  six o'clock       Friday(s)           May
  the weekend       Sunday morning(s)   spring/summer
  night             2 August            the morning/
  noon              6 May, 1978         evening/afternoon
                                        1998

DIQQAT — ISTISNOLAR:
  at NIGHT       (in the night EMAS)
  at the WEEKEND (Britaniyada; AQShda 'on the weekend')
  at NOON        (tush payti)
  IN the morning/evening/afternoon — LEKIN
  ON Sunday morning — aniq kun aytilsa ON!

table.subject: AT
table.full: six o'clock, the weekend, night, noon

keyRules.uzRule: AT — soat bilan va 'the weekend', 'night', 'noon' so'zlari bilan.
keyRules.enRule: We use at with the time and with the weekend, night and noon.

keyRules.uzRule: ON — hafta kunlari, aniq kunning qismlari va sanalar bilan.
keyRules.enRule: We use on with days of the week, the parts of a particular day and dates.

keyRules.uzRule: IN — oylar, fasllar, yillar va 'the morning/evening/afternoon' bilan.
keyRules.enRule: We use in with months, seasons, years and with the morning/evening/afternoon.

rule.warningUz:
ENG CHALKASH JOY — 'morning' bilan IN va ON:

  IN the morning        — umuman ertalab (har kuni)
  ON Sunday morning     — ANIQ kunning ertalabi
  ON Monday afternoons  — dushanba kunlari kunduzi

QOIDA: kun NOMI aytilsa → ON, aytilmasa → IN.

Va 'night' — ISTISNO:
  ✅ at night          ❌ in the night
  LEKIN: on Friday night (kun nomi bor → ON)
rule.noteUz:
PREDLOGSIZ ishlatiladigan vaqt so'zlari:
  every day / week / month / year
  this morning / week / year
  next Monday / week
  last night / week
  today, tomorrow, yesterday

  ✅ I go there every day.
  ❌ I go there in every day.
rule.extraUz:
SANA O'QILISHI (og'zaki):
  2 August    → the second of August
              → August the second (AQShda)
  6 May 1978  → the sixth of May, nineteen seventy-eight

YIL O'QILISHI:
  1978 → nineteen seventy-eight
  1998 → nineteen ninety-eight
  2005 → two thousand and five
  2024 → twenty twenty-four

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again and make notes under the following headings. Close your books, look at your notes and talk about Bob's daily routine and free-time activities. Start like this: Bob is a dolphin trainer. He gets up at five o'clock in the morning...
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni qayta o'qing va sarlavhalar bo'yicha qayd yozing. Kitobni yoping, qaydlarga qarab Bobning kundalik tartibi va bo'sh vaqti haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHALAR:
  Bob's job:      — Bobning kasbi
  What Bob does:  — Bob nima qiladi
    in the morning   — ertalab
    in the afternoon — kunduzi
    in the evening   — kechqurun
    in his free time — bo'sh vaqtida

KITOB BERGAN BOSHLANISH:
  'Bob is a dolphin trainer. He gets up at five o'clock
   in the morning...'

QAYD OLISH — matnni to'liq yodlamang, faqat KALIT so'zlarni yozing:
  morning: get up 5:00 → shower → dressed → breakfast →
           bus 6:00 → aquarium 6:30 → feed dolphins → practise

So'ng qaydlarga qarab O'Z SO'ZINGIZ bilan gapiring.

tasks.answer: Bob is a dolphin trainer. He works at an aquarium.
tasks.whyUz: Kitob shu gap bilan boshlashni taklif qiladi.

tasks.answer: He gets up at five o'clock in the morning, has a shower and gets dressed.
After breakfast, at about six o'clock, he catches the bus to work.
He arrives at the aquarium at half past six and feeds the dolphins. Then they practise for the show until lunchtime.
He has a break for lunch from half past twelve till half past one, and then the show starts.
At five o'clock he feeds the dolphins again and then he goes home.
In the evening he usually watches TV. He doesn't go out very often because he goes to bed early.
In his free time he loves going for long walks in the countryside with his dog, Jack.
He also likes swimming at the pool, but he never swims in the sea because he is afraid of sharks.
Bob feels very satisfied with his life because he has got a great job and he enjoys his free time.

  I have lunch AT half past twelve.

Quyidagi namunalar — o'z vaqtlaringizni qo'ying.

tasks.answer: In the morning, I get up at seven o'clock.
I have a shower and then I get dressed.

School finishes at two o'clock and I go back home.
In the evening, I do my homework.
After that, I usually watch TV or read a book.
I have dinner at seven o'clock and I go to bed at about ten.

exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL QOLIPI:
  How often do you + fe'l + ... ?

JAVOB VARIANTLARI (kitobdagi ro'yxat):
  never                          — hech qachon
  every day / month / evening    — har kuni / oy / kechqurun
  every two / three days         — ikki / uch kunda bir
  every Sunday                   — har yakshanba
  sometimes                      — ba'zan
  once / twice a week / month    — haftada/oyda bir/ikki marta

DIQQAT — SON IFODALARI:
  once  = bir marta ('one time' EMAS)
  twice = ikki marta ('two times' EMAS)
  three times = uch marta (3 dan boshlab 'times')

NAMUNA:
  SA: How often do you go to the swimming-pool?
  SB: Twice a week.
  SA: How often do you go to the theatre?
  SB: Never...

SO'NG XATBOSHI yoziladi (3-shaxsda!):
  'Tony GOES to the swimming-pool twice a week,
   but he NEVER GOES to the theatre.'

  Sarlavha: Welcome to ... (mamlakatingiz nomi)
  Shops
  Banks and Post Offices
  Chemists

  ... are open + kun(lar) + FROM ... UNTIL ...

tasks.answer: Shops are open Monday to Saturday from 9 am until 8 pm.
On Sunday many shops are open from 10 am until 6 pm.
Banks are open Monday to Friday from 9 am until 5 pm.
Post offices are open Monday to Saturday from 9 am until 6 pm.
Chemists are open every day from 8 am until 10 pm. Some chemists stay open all night.
Restaurants are generally open for lunch from 12 am until 4 pm.
They are open for dinner from 6 pm until 11 pm.
There are also some restaurants which stay open late in the big cities.

wordFormation.explanationUz: 'get' fe'li ko'p turg'un birikmalarda uchraydi. Ularni butun holda yodlang.
Ovqat va yuvinish 'have' fe'li bilan aytiladi — bu o'zbekchadan farq qiladi.
Ba'zilarida 'to' bor, ba'zilarida yo'q — bu eng ko'p xato manbai.
-ing narsani tasvirlaydi (u shunday qiladi), -ed odamni tasvirlaydi (u shunday his qiladi).
Bu sifatlar ma'lum predlog talab qiladi — juftlik holida yodlang.
To'rtta so'z bilan istalgan vaqtni aytish mumkin.
Chet elga chiqqanda darhol kerak bo'ladigan so'zlar.
Bitta harf farqi ma'noni butunlay o'zgartiradi.
Eng ko'p xato shu yerda. Uch guruhni farqlang.
Bu so'zlarning ba'zilari Britan va Amerika inglizchasida farq qiladi.
Bu farq ingliz tilida juda muhim va o'zbek tilida yo'q.
Ish vaqtini aytishning standart usullari.

wordFormation.ruleUz: Pul va mijoz bilan bog'liq fe'llar
wordFormation.explanationUz: Ish haqida gapirganda kerak bo'ladi.
Sport va dam olish mashg'ulotlari uchun 'go' + -ing ishlatiladi. Bu qolipda 'to' YO'Q.
JOY nomi bilan 'to' shart. Mashg'ulot bilan esa 'to' yo'q.
0% dan 100% gacha. Har birining o'z darajasi bor.
Uy ishlari ko'pincha 'do the ...' shaklida.
Ravishdan tashqari, gap OXIRIDA turadigan iboralar ham bor.

wordFormation.ruleUz: Oy nomlari — hammasi KATTA harf bilan
wordFormation.explanationUz: Ko'pchiligi rim xudolari va imperatorlari nomidan. Oxirgi to'rttasi lotincha sonlardan.
Sanalar TARTIB SON bilan aytiladi. Birinchi uchtasi noto'g'ri shakl.
1 va 2 uchun maxsus so'zlar bor, 3 dan boshlab 'times'.
Genri haqidagi matndagi so'zlar.

sentencePatterns.formula: His/Her day starts AT + soat + IN THE + kun qismi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: His day starts at five o'clock in the morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning kuni ertalab soat beshda boshlanadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Soat bilan AT, kun qismi bilan IN THE (morning/afternoon/evening).
ISTISNO: at night ('in the night' EMAS).

sentencePatterns.formula: He gets up, has a shower, and then he gets dressed.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He gets up, has a shower, and then he gets dressed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U turadi, dush qabul qiladi, so'ng kiyinadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ketma-ket harakatlar vergul bilan, oxirgisidan oldin 'and then'.
Har bir fe'l 3-shaxs -s oladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: He catches the bus TO work. He arrives AT + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He catches the bus to work. He arrives at the aquarium at half past six.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ishga avtobusga chiqadi. Akvariumga olti yarimda yetib boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'catch the bus' — avtobusga chiqmoq.
'arrive AT' — kichik joy (bino), 'arrive IN' — shahar/mamlakat.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody has a break FROM + vaqt + TILL + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Bob has a break for lunch from half past twelve till half past one.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bob o'n ikki yarimdan bir yarimgacha tanaffus qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'from ... till/to ...' — davomiylik. Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

sentencePatterns.formula: He doesn't + fe'l + very often BECAUSE + sabab.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He doesn't go out very often during the week because he goes to bed early.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U hafta davomida tez-tez ko'chaga chiqmaydi, chunki erta yotadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'very often' inkor bilan — 'unchalik tez-tez emas'.
'during' + ot ('during the week').

sentencePatterns.formula: He NEVER + fe'l + BECAUSE he's afraid OF + narsa.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He never swims in the sea because he's afraid of sharks.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U dengizda hech qachon suzmaydi, chunki akuladan qo'rqadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'never' o'zi inkor — 'doesn't' KERAK EMAS.
'afraid OF' — predlog shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: I feel + sifat + WITH + narsa.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I feel very satisfied with my life at the moment.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hozir hayotimdan juda mamnunman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'feel' dan keyin sifat (ravish emas): feel GOOD (feel well ham bo'ladi).
'satisfied WITH' — predlog shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: What time is it? / What's the time? — It's + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What time is it? — It's (a) quarter to seven.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Soat necha? — Yettiga chorak qoldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ikkala savol ham bir xil. Javob doim 'It's' bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's + daqiqa + PAST + soat. (1–30 daqiqa)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's twenty past nine. It's half past four.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: To'qqizdan yigirma o'tdi. To'rt yarim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 30 dan kam daqiqada PAST va SHU soat aytiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's + daqiqa + TO + KEYINGI soat. (31–59 daqiqa)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's ten to three. It's (a) quarter to nine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uchga o'n qoldi. To'qqizga chorak qoldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
60 dan daqiqani ayirasiz va soatni BITTAGA OSHIRASIZ.
2:50 → 60−50=10 → ten to THREE (ikki emas, uch!)

sentencePatterns.formula: What time does the plane FROM + shahar + arrive? — It arrives AT + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What time does the plane from Tokyo arrive? — It arrives at (a) quarter past five.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tokiodan keladigan samolyot qachon keladi? — U beshdan chorak o'tganda keladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
KELISH uchun: FROM + shahar, ARRIVE fe'li.
Soat bilan AT predlogi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What time does the plane FOR + shahar + leave? — It leaves AT + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What time does the plane for New York leave? — It leaves at twenty past seven.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nyu-Yorkka ketadigan samolyot qachon jo'naydi? — U yettidan yigirma o'tganda jo'naydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: JO'NASH uchun: FOR + shahar, LEAVE fe'li.

sentencePatterns.formula: He + fe'l+S + AT + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He gets up at five o'clock. He arrives at the aquarium at half past six.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U soat beshda turadi. U akvariumga olti yarimda yetib boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Soat bilan doim AT. Fe'l 3-shaxs birlikda -s oladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X are open + kun(lar) + FROM + vaqt + UNTIL + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Shops are open Monday to Friday from 9 am until 6 pm.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Do'konlar dushanbadan jumagacha ertalab 9 dan kechqurun 6 gacha ochiq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ish vaqtini aytishning standart qolipi.
Kun oralig'i uchun 'to', vaqt oralig'i uchun 'from ... until ...'.

sentencePatterns.formula: ON + kun + FROM + vaqt + UNTIL + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: On Saturday from 9 am until 4 or 5 pm.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shanba kuni ertalab 9 dan kunduzi 4 yoki 5 gacha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Alohida kun uchun ON predlogi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What time do + ko'plik ega + open/close?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What time do shops close on Saturday? — They close at 4 or 5 pm.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Do'konlar shanba kuni soat nechada yopiladi? — Soat 4 yoki 5 da.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik ega bilan DO. Javobda soat oldida AT.

sentencePatterns.formula: Some X stay open + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Some chemists stay open to cover evenings, nights and weekends.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ba'zi dorixonalar kechqurun, tunda va dam olish kunlarida ochiq turadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'stay open' = ochiq qolmoq. 'stay' dan keyin sifat keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are some X WHICH + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are some restaurants which stay open late in the big cities.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Katta shaharlarda kech ochiq turadigan restoranlar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'which' — NARSA uchun bog'lovchi ('who' — odam uchun).
O'zbekchada '-adigan' qo'shimchasi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I feel + SIFAT + BECAUSE + sabab.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I feel happy because I enjoy my work.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'zimni baxtli his qilaman, chunki ishimdan zavqlanaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'feel' dan keyin SIFAT (ravish emas).
'because' bilan sabab — bu mashqning asosiy maqsadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + fe'l+S + AT + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Kim gets up at 7:30 in the morning every weekday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kim har ish kuni ertalab 7:30 da turadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Kundalik tartib — Present Simple. Soat bilan AT.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + RAVISH + fe'l (oddiy fe'l bilan).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I usually get up at half past seven. She never goes climbing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men odatda yetti yarimda turaman. U hech qachon toqqa chiqmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ravish fe'ldan OLDIN turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + am/is/are + RAVISH + ... ('to be' bilan).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I am never late for school. He is always happy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men maktabga hech qachon kechikmayman. U doim xursand.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'to be' bilan ravish KEYIN turadi — bu yagona istisno.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + RAVISH + fe'l+S + ON + kun (ko'plikda).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Laura never goes climbing on Sundays.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Laura yakshanba kunlari hech qachon toqqa chiqmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'on Sundays' — ko'plikda, 'har yakshanba' degani.
'never' bilan 'doesn't' KERAK EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: She leaves home at ... and catches the bus to school.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She leaves home at about 8:15 and catches the bus to school.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U taxminan 8:15 da uydan chiqadi va maktabga avtobusga chiqadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'leave home' — 'from' kerak emas.
'about' = taxminan (aniq vaqt emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: After that, she usually + fe'l+S.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: After that, she usually watches TV.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shundan keyin u odatda televizor ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'After that' — ketma-ketlikni ko'rsatadi, keyin vergul.
Ravish baribir fe'ldan oldin turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: How often do you + fe'l? — Once/Twice a week. / Never. / Every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How often do you go to the swimming-pool? — Twice a week.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Basseynga qanchalik tez-tez borasiz? — Haftada ikki marta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'How often' — takrorlanishni so'raydi. Javob to'liq gap bo'lishi shart emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody + fe'l+S + takrorlanish, BUT he/she NEVER + fe'l+S + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tony goes to the swimming-pool twice a week, but he never goes to the theatre.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toni haftada ikki marta basseynga boradi, lekin teatrga hech qachon bormaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ijobiy va salbiy odatni 'but' bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yish.

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody was born ON + kun/sana, IN + yil, AT + soat, AT night / IN the morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom was born on Friday the 22nd of March, in 1957, at half past ten at night.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom 1957-yil 22-mart, juma kuni kechasi o'n yarimda tug'ilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
To'rtta predlog bir gapda — har biri o'z qoidasi bo'yicha.
Sana o'qilishida 'the' va 'of' qo'shiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: AT + soat, IN + kun qismi, ON + kun nomi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He wakes up at half past four in the morning. On Sundays, Henry relaxes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ertalab to'rt yarimda uyg'onadi. Yakshanba kunlari Genri dam oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kun NOMI bo'lsa ON, bo'lmasa IN:
  in the afternoon ↔ ON Saturday afternoons

sentencePatterns.formula: somebody goes to + joy + TO + fe'l (maqsad).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He goes to the local playing-field to watch the village team play football.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qishloq jamoasining futbolini tomosha qilish uchun mahalliy sport maydoniga boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikkinchi 'to' MAQSADNI bildiradi ('...ish uchun').
'watch somebody DO something' — 'to' KERAK EMAS: watch the team PLAY.

sentencePatterns.formula: fe'l-ING + ... makes me feel + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Working in the open air makes me feel good.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ochiq havoda ishlash o'zimni yaxshi his qildiradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
-ing shakli gap EGASI bo'la oladi.
'make somebody FEEL' — 'to' KERAK EMAS.
